summary: RELX PLC filed a Form 6-K reporting the results of its Annual General Meeting held on April 23, 2026. The filing details voting results on 21 routine resolutions, including receiving the annual report, approving director remuneration, re-electing directors, reappointing the auditor, and authorizing share allotment and buybacks. All resolutions passed with overwhelming majority support. There are no special situation elements such as acquisitions, divestitures, or other corporate events. This is a routine periodic filing of a foreign private issuer, with no special-situation catalyst.
